evaluation_units: Distinct recordings; average clean/noisy and sampling seeds within each recording for paired uncertainty. Also report each regime separately.

other_dataset_world_maximum_regression.rule: allow the larger tolerance, separately per dataset/regime

foot_speed_maximum_regression.rule: allow the larger tolerance for macro and RICH per regime

scene_evidence: Report same-model scene-on/off on independent recording panels with identical observations/reference/seeds; an ablation alone does not establish that fusion improved over its control.
early_gate: At 1000 updates use dev recordings only; finite loss or training-loss decrease is not acceptance. Stop or revise only on declared material regressions, numerical errors, or implementation faults; do not select confirmation checkpoints repeatedly.
scope_limit: 43 sampled VAL windows, not all RICH VAL windows or any official TEST result; limited seeds cannot prove universal improvement. No automatic promotion over protected official models.
